detail.longDescription: Hi HN , I'm Abhinav Prakash and I built Agent Doctor. It lets a domain expert (lawyer, doctor, banker) change steps in an AI agent and re-run it on your own servers, without code changes or redeploys. I would like to learn: how does your domain expert's feedback reach your agent today? I'd also really value a review of what I built, what's missing and what's wrong. Thanks !
